claims_checked.claim: Japan has a very high density of vending machines relative to many countries.
claims_checked.note: Industry estimates vary by year; avoid a single absolute number without source year.

claims_checked.claim: Machines sell hot and cold drinks and many niche products.
claims_checked.note: True but assortment varies by location.

claims_checked.claim: Low vandalism alone fully explains density.
claims_checked.note: Safety helps; denser urban demand, land use, and 24h access also matter.
